moments.text: IR view with an orange crosshair over a harbour: breakwaters, docked ships and buildings. Black redaction boxes sit on grey side panels.
The view swings off the harbour onto open water; a large dark patch fills the area above the crosshair.
Display change: the dark patch flips to a bright white glow above the crosshair.
A small white dash enters at the lower-left edge, climbs past just above left of the crosshair and leaves at the top by 1:30.8.
The screen flashes black twice, at 1:44 and 1:47.5, about 0.2 s each; the glow above the crosshair stays.
Small dark dots drift across the streaked water surface, one or two at a time, as the sensor pans after them.
The screen goes black for ~0.3 s; afterwards a dark dot sits just below right of the crosshair as tracking continues.

notes: Record title says 'UAP on 25SEP19'; the official summary quotes the uploader title as 'UAPs on 23SEP19'. The official 00:45 left-to-lower-left object is not visible in the frames.
